seoTitle: How to Change the Name on a Stripe Invoice
metaDescription: Update the business name and address shown on Stripe invoices and receipts by adjusting your account's branding settings.
intro: The name and address shown on your Stripe invoices and receipts should reflect exactly how you want your business to appear to customers. This guide walks through where to find Stripe's branding settings and how to update or remove business details on your receipts.

steps.heading: Open your Stripe account settings
steps.body: Log into Stripe and navigate to the branding or business settings section.

steps.heading: Find the invoice and receipt customization options
steps.body: Locate the specific settings that control what name and address details appear on generated invoices and receipts.

steps.heading: Update the business name
steps.body: Edit the business name field so it displays exactly what you want customers to see on receipts.

steps.heading: Edit or remove the address
steps.body: Adjust or remove the address details shown, depending on what information you want to keep visible.

steps.heading: Preview and save your changes
steps.body: Preview a sample invoice or receipt to confirm the updated details display correctly before saving.

faq.question: Can I completely remove my address from Stripe receipts?
faq.answer: Depending on your account settings and regional requirements, you may be able to remove or minimize the address shown on receipts.

faq.question: Will changing the business name affect past invoices?
faq.answer: Typically, past invoices remain unchanged, and the update only affects newly generated invoices and receipts going forward.

faq.question: Where exactly are these branding settings located?
faq.answer: They're generally found within your Stripe account's business or branding settings, separate from individual payment settings.

faq.question: Is this the same as changing my legal business name with Stripe?
faq.answer: No, updating your display name for receipts is different from updating your legal business information tied to your Stripe account verification.
